fichas.title: Room Acoustics
fichas.summary: Guidance on using secondary structures, reflection surfaces, absorbing surfaces, and seating to control reverberation and sound distribution. Secondary structures can compensate for shortcomings in the primary structure. Diffuse reflections help produce uniform reverberation, while resonant surfaces, cavity absorbers, and porous materials absorb different frequency ranges. Seating absorption should be consistent whether seats are occupied or not.
uses: Absorb sound at different frequency ranges
